title: Central West Alerts 1.11.2
changes: The live map can show aircraft from adsb.lol alongside the local PiAware receiver, with a configurable search radius and a 10-second cache option.
Aircraft popups now use a consistent layout across both feeds and show their data source.

Fire, rescue, aeromedical and police aircraft are identified using the NAFC register or a maintained callsign catalogue. Map colours are red for fire, green for rescue and medical, and blue for police.
Aircraft identified as military by the ADS-B provider use a distinct purple colour. Aircraft labels indicate identity, not whether they are responding to an incident.
